items: G2-03 (S10B-2 credit-otherwise data column squeezed to 1-2 chars/line) + G2-04 (S10B-1 credit-view rate bar over the CC badge)
g2_04_first_check: The candidate DOES carry the pre-freeze credit-rate correction block ([id*=u-credit] :is(div,ul).creditRate{display:inline-flex;float:right;text-align:start}); in the S10 modal composition it is insufficient — the rate bar still reaches the badge corner and the otherwise box collapses.
mechanism: In the S10 shell the credit modal box shrink-wraps its content inside the grid-centered container: measured #u-credit-otherwise .modalbox width 149px and .credit.otherwise content width 66px at a 390px viewport (capture visual diagnostics), so the data columns collapse to 1-2 characters. A container-width rule did not change the otherwise box; a definite modalbox width does. With the box at full width the otherwise text lays out normally and the credit-view footer row gains room: the rate bar and the CC badge cluster sit side by side without overlap.
